profile.name: Likhith N Gowda
profile.tagline: Software Engineer | Java Specialist | Gen AI Enthusiast
profile.specialization: Java • SAP BTP • Gen AI • Full-Stack
profile.bio:
Results-driven Software Engineer and M.Tech graduate from BITS Pilani with 2+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade software at SAP Labs India. Core expertise in full-stack Java development, cloud-native architectures (SAP BTP), and agile methodologies. Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance systems and transforming complex business challenges into elegant software solutions.

Key Achievements:
• Legacy Modernization: Led end-to-end Java 8 → 17 migration, refactoring core architecture and testing infrastructure (PowerMockito → Mockito), achieving zero-regression deployment
• Platform Engineering: Built automated state-sync mechanisms for SAP Fiori Elements, eliminating UX bottlenecks
• Performance Optimization: Improved database query performance by 30% (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and read performance by 40% via Redis caching
• Developer Experience: Founded "Synergy Bytes" cross-team workshops, reducing duplicated effort; cut onboarding time via internal tooling
• Observability & Security: Designed Dynatrace dashboards with automated threat detection alerts
• AI/ML Integration: Master's dissertation on computer vision waste segregation using fastai/Python

experience.summary: Designed and developed scalable enterprise Java applications on SAP Business Technology Platform, contributing to core product modules used by thousands of enterprise clients globally. Built and maintained RESTful microservices using Spring Boot, improving system modularity and enabling independent deployment of services, reducing release cycle time by ~20%.
highlights: Orchestrated comprehensive migration of legacy Java 8 codebase to Java 17, refactoring core architecture to align with modern Java standards (modules, records, pattern matching, sealed classes) and migrated PowerMockito → standard Mockito achieving zero-regression deployment
Implemented optimization strategies in MySQL and PostgreSQL, writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures, improving query performance by up to 30%

Architected automated state-sync mechanism for SAP Fiori Elements custom tile generation that dynamically intercepts unsaved UI filter states and triggers data retrieval—ensuring flawless app-state preservation without manual intervention

Engineered zero-touch beta validation pipeline using Selenium WebDriver to monitor and validate Beta feature availability in live tenant environments, replacing manual QA checks and reclaiming 20+ hours/week of developer bandwidth

Spearheaded development of comprehensive system health dashboard using Dynatrace to proactively monitor request-response latencies, error rates, and critical architectural metrics with automated threshold alerts for abnormal API behaviors
Founded and organized "Synergy Bytes" workshop series bridging teams across SAP UX Engineering LOB, cutting duplicated effort across parallel initiatives
Contributed to internal developer tooling and documentation, reducing onboarding time for new engineers by streamlining technical knowledge transfer
Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, maintaining code coverage above 85% and significantly reducing production defect rates

experience.summary: Developed and tested software modules for embedded and IoT-based systems, gaining cross-disciplinary exposure in both software engineering and hardware interfacing.
highlights: Collaborated with a small engineering team to debug and resolve integration issues between software and hardware components, improving system reliability
Wrote clean, documented code and contributed to code review sessions, applying software engineering best practices in a fast-paced startup environment
